CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2832 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head a6c6bd8eaaae1acedcb8d25d6fdad5057573a5aa. Bus nonce: 8fc0fc5229de3eb19934a2eafd43f2a8. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin a6c6bd8eaaae1acedcb8d25d6fdad5057573a5aa`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge a6c6bd8eaaae1acedcb8d25d6fdad5057573a5aa` or `Fix review: blocked a6c6bd8eaaae1acedcb8d25d6fdad5057573a5aa <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 8fc0fc5229de3eb19934a2eafd43f2a8`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `a6c6bd8eaaae1acedcb8d25d6fdad5057573a5aa` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2832 a6c6bd8eaaae1acedcb8d25d6fdad5057573a5aa") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2832-8fc0fc52`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
DELTA FIX REVIEW (round 2) of #2832, R10-LEGIONELLA-COMPLETION (topic r10-legionella-completion), head a6c6bd8eaaae1acedcb8d25d6fdad5057573a5aa, bus nonce 8fc0fc5229de3eb19934a2eafd43f2a8, per dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md (origin/main), from a detached worktree at the head SHA, with the FINDER's harness (never the fixer's). The previous verdict is the PR comment 6403868037 (blocked at d076f22c99f852a822856cc78956a7ed84ab6daa, mutation-vacuous): read it first with gh api repos/tvofi/heatpump_optimizer/issues/comments/6403868037; the block is 8 added sites that survived every driver while the body said all 25 were pinned: legionella.py:345 CMP_BOUND, 350 CLAMP_DROP, 60 CMP_BOUND, 621 CMP_BOUND and GUARD_OFF, 655 BOOLOP, 658 GUARD_OFF, 701 GUARD_OFF (line numbers are at d076f22c: re-map them at this head). The round-2 fixer's task (brief: add a killing check per live site proved red on the real file with the one line mutated and green on the null control, correct the body's ## Unpinned sites, answer the reds) is what you judge.
CHECK, by measuring at this head: (1) for each of the 8 sites, re-mutate that one line in a copy of the real file and run the pinning check: it must go red; and the unmutated null control green. Any site that still survives is a block. Also re-run the site enumeration the mutation table uses (tests/mutation, dev/audit) and compare to the body's ## Unpinned sites: any newly added site not pinned and not triaged is a block; any body figure that does not reproduce is a finding. (2) ## Red checks names and answers exactly the reds the head's runs show (read check-runs from the API; the gate had gone red on the installation rate limit at 04:52Z and was rerun: those reds died before any test body and are infra, a rerun green is the answer; state which of the head's check-runs are green now). (3) three-dot diff only; VERSION, manifest, RELEASE_NOTES and claim files untouched unless the body claims a drift (then claims-for must equal VERSION); python3 -I tools/audit/carry_audit.py pr 2832: 0 unrouted; dev/programme/delivery/2832.md present in the diff; git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main head exits 0. Re-read refs/pull/2832/head with git ls-remote before writing and say if it moved.
Output: write verdict.md in a fresh directory of your own. First line exactly "Fix review: merge a6c6bd8eaaae1acedcb8d25d6fdad5057573a5aa" or "Fix review: blocked a6c6bd8eaaae1acedcb8d25d6fdad5057573a5aa <class>: <reason>" (no brackets; class lower-case letters and dashes). Then a blank line, then "bus-nonce: 8fc0fc5229de3eb19934a2eafd43f2a8". Then sections: a blocked verdict's block under "## Block"; each finding this PR does not settle is its own bullet under "## Findings" ending in "Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>"; the rest under "## Evidence" with files under ev/, one holding the full 40-hex head. Return it on a probe ref: the commit is built with a private index as the role file gives, then pushed to refs/heads/probe/rev-2832-8fc0fc52. Do NOT run bus.sh. Do not post comments, approve or merge. No Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer, no claude.ai link in any commit. Name no path under a home directory in the verdict.
